references.text: The promise of well-being and long life in the land is linked to honoring parents, which is part of keeping God's commands.
Moses expresses God's desire that the people always keep His commands so that they may prosper and live long in the land.
The same theme about keeping God's statutes and commands to prosper and multiply in the land flowing with milk and honey.
The command to keep the Lord's commands so that it may go well with them and they may enter the promised land.
The promise of long life is linked to keeping all the commands that Moses gives.
The promise that it will go well with them and their children when they do what is right in the Lord's eyes.
An exhortation to keep the commands so that it may go well with them and their descendants forever.
The promise of long life linked to obedience to God's commands, here about letting the mother bird fly away.
The command to honor father and mother with the promise of long life in the land the Lord gives.
Whoever keeps God's statutes and laws shall live by them.
Paul quotes the command to honor parents with the promise that it will go well with you and you will live long in the land.
